settings.heading: Shipping Policy
settings.intro: Clear delivery timelines and fees for orders across Pakistan.
settings.body:
Delivery timelines

Most orders are dispatched within 24–48 hours after COD verification and arrive in 3–5 working days via partners such as TCS, CallCourier, Leopards, or PostEx.

Shipping fees

  • Standard flat rate: PKR 200 (unless a free-shipping promo applies)
  • Free shipping on orders above PKR 3,000 when the promotion is active

Order processing

  1. Place your order and select Cash on Delivery at Shopify Checkout.
  2. Our team may confirm your phone number on WhatsApp.
  3. Parcel is packed, labeled, and handed to the courier.
  4. You receive tracking updates until doorstep delivery.

Remote areas may take additional working days. Public holidays can extend timelines.
